caption: Actual SMD(MeCN) phthalimide five-repeat geometries from the twelve-state finite baseline. Adjacent sites (2,3) and one-spacer sites (2,4) each have a close-core and a separated-core local minimum. Numbers identify the occupied repeats on the open backbone; ungrafted site 3 in the one-spacer model retains benzyl chloride. Hydrogens are hidden; these orthographic projections use proper rotations of the saved XYZ coordinates and a common spatial scale. Covalent bonds follow the exact checked graph. Conformer ΔG is relative to the lower G in the same two-pose occupancy graph at 298.15 K and a 50 cm^-1 cutoff. These within-graph differences include backbone and solvent response; four-state site nonadditivity is a distinct quantity. The sampled pairs do not establish a converged ensemble, isolated core binding or an electron-transfer rate.
